params.changeNote:
This parameter now accepts string expressions. The result is read like a regular `attr` value. This also applies to the `attr` parameters of other state controllers.

Example: `attr = ifelse(random < 500, "S, NA", "A, SP")`
params.name: attr
params.description:
This is the attribute of the attack. It is used to determine if the attack can hit P2. It has the format:

attr = *arg1*, *arg2*

Where: *arg1* is either `S`, `C` or `A`. Similar to `statetype` for the StateDef, this says whether the attack is a standing, crouching, or aerial attack.

*arg2* is a 2-character string. The first character is either `N` for `normal`, `S` for `special`, or `H` for `hyper` (or `super`, as it is commonly known). The second character must be either `A` for `attack` (a normal hit attack), `T` for `throw`, or `P` for projectile.

params.changeNote:
This parameter now accepts string expressions. The result is read like a regular `hitflag` value. This also applies to the `hitflag`/`guardflag` parameters of other state controllers.

Example: `hitflag = ifelse(random < 500, "M", "A")`
params.name: hitflag
params.description:
This determines what type of state P2 must be in for P1 to hit. *hit_flags* is a string containing a combination of the following characters:

`H` for `high`, `L` for `low` or `A` for air. `M` (mid) is equivalent to saying `HL`. `F` is for fall, and if included will allow P1 to juggle falling opponents in the air. `D` is for `lying Down`, and if included allows P1 to hit opponents lying down on the ground. `H`, `L` or `A` (or `M`) must be present in the hitflag string.

Two optional characters are `+` and `-`. If `+` is added, then the hit only affects people in a gethit state. This may be useful for chain-moves that should not affect opponents who were not hit by the first move in the…

params.name: guardflag
params.description:
This determines how P2 may guard the attack. hit_flags is a string containing a combination of the following characters:

`H` for `high`, `L` for `low` or `A` for air. `M` (mid) is equivalent to saying `HL`. If omitted, defaults to an empty string, meaning P2 cannot guard the attack.

params.name: affectteam
params.description: *team_type* specifies which team's players can be hit by this HitDef. Use B for both teams (all players), E for enemy team (opponents), or F for friendly team (your own team). The default is E.

params.name: animtype
params.description: This refers to the type of animation that P2 will go into when hit by the attack. Choose from `light`, `medium`, `hard`, `back`, `up`, or `diagup`. The first three are self-explanatory. `Back` is the animation where P2 is knocked off her feet. `Up` should be used when the character is knocked straight up in the air (for instance, by an uppercut), and `DiagUp` should be used when the character is knocked up and backwards in the air, eventually landing on his head. The default is `Light`.

params.name: air.animtype
params.description: Similar to the `animtype` parameter, this is the animtype to set P2 to if P2 is in the air, instead of on the ground. Defaults to the same value as the `animtype` parameter if omitted.

params.name: fall.animtype
params.description: Similar to the `animtype` parameter, this is the animtype to set P2 to if P2 is hit while falling. Defaults to `Up` if air.animtype is `Up`, or `Back` otherwise.

params.name: priority
params.description:
Specifies the priority for this hit. Hits with higher priorities take precedence over hits with lower priorities. Valid values for *hit_prior* are 1-7. Defaults to 4.

*hit_type*, if specified, gives the priority class of the hit. Valid priority classes are Dodge, Hit, and Miss. The priority class determines the tiebreaking behavior when P1 and P2 hit each other simultaneously with equal priorities. The behavior for P1 vs. P2 is as follows:

- Hit vs. Hit: both P1 and P2 are hit
- Hit vs. Miss: P1 hits, P2 misses
- Hit vs. Dodge: Both miss
- Dodge vs. Dodge: Both miss
- Dodge vs. Miss: Both miss
- Miss vs. Miss: Both miss

In the case of a no-hit tie, the respective HitDefs stay enabled.…

params.name: damage
params.description: *hit_damage* is the damage that P2 takes when hit by P2. The optional *guard_damage* parameter is the damage taken by P2 if the hit is guarded. Both default to zero if omitted.

params.name: pausetime
params.description: This is the time that each player will pause on the hit. *p1_pausetime* is the time to freeze P1, measured in game-ticks. *p2_pausetime* is the time to make P2 shake before recoiling from the hit. Defaults to `0, 0` if omitted.

params.name: guard.pausetime
params.description: Similar to the `pausetime` parameter, these are the times to pause each player if the hit was guarded. Defaults to the same values as the `pausetime` parameter if omitted.

params.name: sparkno
params.description: This is the action number of the spark to display if the hit is successful. To play a spark out of the player's .AIR file, precede the action number with an S, e.g. `sparkno = S10`. Defaults to the value set in the player's constants if omitted.

params.name: guard.sparkno
params.description: This is the action number of the spark to display if the hit was guarded. To play a spark out of the player's .AIR file, precede the action number with an S. Defaults to the value set in the player's constants if omitted.

params.name: sparkxy
params.description: This is where to make the hit/guard spark. *spark_x* is a coordinate relative to the front of P2. A negative value makes the spark deeper inside P2. `Front` refers to the x-position at P2's axis offset towards P1 by the corresponding width value in the [Size] group in P2's player constants. *spark_y* is relative to P1. A negative value makes a spark higher up. You can use a tool like AirView to determine this value by positioning the cursor at the `attack spot` and reading off the value of the y-position. Defaults to `0, 0` if omitted.

params.name: hitsound
params.description: This is the sound to play on hit (from common.snd). The included fight.snd lets you choose from 5,0 (light hit sound) through to 5,4 (painful whack). To play a sound from the player's own SND file, precede the first number with an `S`. For example, `hitsound = S1,0`. Defaults to the value set in the player constants if omitted.

params.name: guardsound
params.description: This is the sound to play on guard (from common.snd). Only 6,0 is available at this time. To play a sound from the player's own SND file, precede the first number with an `S`. There is no facility to play a sound from the opponent's SND file. Defaults to the value set in the player constants if omitted.

params.name: ground.type
params.description:
This is the kind of attack if P2 is on the ground. Choose from:
- `High`: for attacks that make P2's head snap backwards.
- `Low`: for attacks that hit P2 in the stomach.
- `Trip`: for low sweep attacks. If you use `Trip` type, the ground.velocity parameter should have a non-zero y-velocity, and the fall parameter should be set to 1. A tripped opponent does not bounce upon falling on the ground.
- `None`: for attacks that do nothing besides pause P1 and P2 for the duration in the pausetime parameter.

If P2 is hit from behind, `High` will be displayed as `Low` and vice-versa. P2's animation for `High` and `Low` types will be superseded if the AnimType parameter is `Back`. Defaults to `High`…

params.name: air.type
params.description: This is the kind of attack if P2 is in the air. Defaults to the same value as `ground.type` if omitted.

params.name: ground.slidetime
params.description: This is the time in game-ticks that P2 will slide back for after being hit (this time does not include the pausetime for P2). Applicable only to hits that keep P2 on the ground. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

params.name: guard.slidetime
params.description: Same as `ground.slidetime`, but this is the value if P2 guards the hit. Defaults to same value as `guard.hittime`.

params.name: ground.hittime
params.description: Time that P2 stays in the hit state after being hit. Adjust this value carefully, to make combos possible. Applicable only to hits that keep P2 on the ground. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

params.changeNote: If the character has `ikemenversion`, this value now defaults to `ground.hittime` as documented, as opposed to `ground.slidetime`.
params.name: guard.hittime
params.description: Same as `ground.hittime`, but this is the value if P2 guards the hit. Defaults to same value as `ground.hittime`.

params.name: air.hittime
params.description: Time that p2 stays in the hit state after being hit in or into the air, before being able to guard again. This parameter has no effect if the `fall` parameter is set to 1. Defaults to 20 if omitted.

params.name: guard.ctrltime
params.description: This is the time before p2 regains control in the ground guard state. Defaults to the same value as `guard.slidetime` if omitted.

params.changeNote: This parameter now takes a second value. It specifies the distance that a player can attack behind the enemy and still allow them to enter proximity guard. This second value defaults to 0.
params.name: guard.dist
params.description: This is the x-distance from P1 in which P2 will go into a guard state if P2 is holding the direction away from P1. Defaults to the value in the player constants if omitted. You normally do not need to use this parameter.

params.name: yaccel
params.description: Specifies the y acceleration to impart to P2 if the hit connects. Defaults to 0.35 in 240p, 0.7 in 480p, 1.4 in 720p.

params.name: ground.velocity
params.description: Initial velocity to give P2 after being hit, if P2 is on the ground. If *y_velocity* is not zero, P2 will be knocked into the air. Both values default to 0 if omitted. You can leave out the *y_velocity* if you want P2 to remain on the ground.

params.changeNote: This parameter now takes a second and a third value. It specifies the Y and the Z guard velocities. They default to 0.
params.name: guard.velocity
params.description: Velocity to give P2 if P2 guards the hit on the ground. Defaults to the *x_velocity* value of the `ground.velocity` parameter if omitted.

params.name: air.velocity
params.description: Initial velocity to give P2 if P2 is hit in the air. Defaults to `0, 0` if omitted.

params.name: airguard.velocity
params.description: Velocity to give P2 if P2 guards the hit in the air. Defaults to *x_velocity* \* 1.5, *y_velocity* / 2, where *x_velocity* and *y_velocity* are values of the `air.velocity` parameter.

params.name: ground.cornerpush.veloff
params.description: Determines the additional velocity (velocity offset) to impart to the player if he lands a ground hit in the corner. Setting this to a higher value will cause the player to be pushed back farther out of the corner. If omitted, default value depends on the attr parameter. If arg1 of attr is `A`, default value is 0. Otherwise, defaults to 1.3 \* guard.velocity.

params.name: air.cornerpush.veloff
params.description: Determines the additional velocity (velocity offset) to impart to the player if he lands a hit to an aerial opponent in the corner. Setting this to a higher value will cause the player to be pushed back farther out of the corner. Defaults to ground.cornerpush.veloff if omitted.

params.name: down.cornerpush.veloff
params.description: Determines the additional velocity (velocity offset) to impart to the player if he lands a hit on a downed opponent in the corner. Setting this to a higher value will cause the player to be pushed back farther out of the corner. Defaults to ground.cornerpush.veloff if omitted.

params.name: guard.cornerpush.veloff
params.description: Determines the additional velocity (velocity offset) to impart to the player if his hit is guarded in the corner. Setting this to a higher value will cause the player to be pushed back farther out of the corner. Defaults to ground.cornerpush.veloff if omitted.

params.name: airguard.cornerpush.veloff
params.description: Determines the additional velocity (velocity offset) to impart to the player if his hit is guarded in the corner. Setting this to a higher value will cause the player to be `pushed back` farther out of the corner. Defaults to guard.cornerpush.veloff if omitted.

params.name: airguard.ctrltime
params.description: This is the time before p2 regains control in the air guard state. Defaults to the same value as `guard.ctrltime` if omitted.

params.name: air.juggle
params.description: The amount of additional juggle points the hit requires. Not to be confused with the `juggle` parameter in the StateDef. You typically do not need this parameter, except for HitDefs of projectiles. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

params.name: maxdist
params.description: These let you control the minimum and maximum distance of P2 relative to P1, after P2 has been hit. These parameters are not commonly used. Defaults to no change in P2's position if omitted.

params.changeNote: This parameter now actually uses the third value. It specifies the P2 Pos Z. `snap` takes 4 arguments the 4th one being snaptime.
params.name: snap
params.description: This moves P2 to the specified position relative to P1 if hit. This parameter is not normally used. If you want to snap P2 to a particular position for a throw, it is recommended you use a `TargetBind` controller in P1's throwing state instead. Defaults to no change in P2's position if omitted.

params.changeNote: In Mugen, the default value for this parameter was not intuitive and often became a problem. In Ikemen, it defaults to no change.
params.name: p1sprpriority
params.description: This is the drawing priority of P1's sprite if the move hits or is guarded by P2. Together with the p2sprpriority parameter, it controls whether or not P1 is drawn in front of or behind P2. The default value is 1.

params.name: p2sprpriority
params.description: This is the drawing priority of P2's sprite if the move hits or is guarded by P2. The default value is 0.

params.name: p1facing
params.description: Set to -1 to make P1 turn around if the hit is successful. The default value is no change in where P1 is facing.

params.name: p1getp2facing
params.description: Set to 1 to have P1 face in the same direction as P2 is facing after the hit connects, and -1 to have P1 face the opposite direction from P2. Defaults to 0 (no change). If nonzero, this parameter takes precedence over p1facing.

params.name: p2facing
params.description: Set to 1 to make P2 face the same direction as P1 if the hit is successful, -1 to make P2 face away. The default value is 0, no change in where P2 is facing.

params.name: p1stateno
params.description: This is the number of the state to set P1 to if the hit is successful. The state must be an attack state (movetype = A) for at least 1 tick. Used mainly for throws. Defaults to -1, no change.

params.name: p2stateno
params.description: This is the number of the state to set P2 to if the hit is successful. P2 will get P1's state and animation data. P2 will retain P1's states and animation data until P2 is hit, or a SelfState controller is used to return P2 to his own states. The state must be a get-hit state (movetype = H) for at least 1 tick. Used mainly for throws; can also be used for custom hit reactions. Defaults to -1, no change.

params.name: p2getp1state
params.description: Set to 0 to prevent P2 from getting P1's state and animation data, in case you do not want that default behaviour of the `p2stateno` parameter. Defaults to 1 if the `p2stateno` parameter is used. Ignored otherwise.

params.name: forcestand
params.description: Set to 1 to force P2 to a standing state-type if the hit is successful, and P2 is in a crouching state. Has no effect if P2 is in an air state. Normally defaults to 0, but if the y_velocity of the `ground.velocity` parameter is non-zero, it defaults to 1.

params.name: fall
params.description: Set to 1 if you want P2 to go into a `fall` state (where P2 hits the ground without regaining control in the air). Use if you want a move to `knock down` P2. Defaults to 0.

params.name: fall.xvelocity
params.description: This is the x-velocity that P2 gets when bouncing off the ground in the `fall` state. Defaults to no change if omitted.

params.name: fall.yvelocity
params.description: This is the y-velocity that P2 gets when bouncing off the ground in the `fall` state. Defaults to -4.5 in 240p, -9 in 480p, -18 in 720p.

params.name: fall.recover
params.description: Set to 0 if you do not want P2 to be able to recover from the `fall` state. Defaults to 1 if omitted (can recover).

params.name: fall.recovertime
params.description: This is the time that must pass before P2 is able to recover from the `fall` state by inputting his recovery command. Does not include the time that P2 is paused for while shaking from the hit. Defaults to 4 if omitted.

params.name: fall.damage
params.description: Indicates the amount of damage to deal when P2 hits the ground out of a falling state. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

params.name: air.fall
params.description: Set to 1 if you want P2 to go into a `fall` state (where P2 hits the ground without regaining control in the air) if hit while P2 is in the air. Defaults to the same value as fall.

params.name: forcenofall
params.description: Set to 1 to force P2 out of a `fall` state, if he is in one. This parameter has no effect on P2 if he is not in a `fall` state. This parameter is ignored if the `fall` parameter is set to 1. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

params.changeNote: This parameter now takes a third value, It specifies the z velocity.
params.name: down.velocity
params.description: This is the velocity to assign P2 if P2 is hit while lying down. If the *y_velocity* is non-zero, P2 will be hit into the air. If it is zero, then P2 will slide back on the ground. Defaults to the same values as the `air.velocity` parameter if omitted.

params.name: down.hittime
params.description: This is the time that P2 will slide back for if P2 is hit while lying down. This parameter is ignored if the *y_velocity* is non-zero for the `down.velocity` parameter.

params.name: down.bounce
params.description: Set to 1 if you want P2 to bounce off the ground one time (using the fall.xvelocity and fall.yvelocity values) after hitting the ground from the hit. This parameter is ignored if the *y_velocity* is zero for the `down.velocity` parameter. Defaults to 0 if omitted (P2 hits the ground and stays there).

params.name: id
params.description: Idetifier for the hit. Used for chain moves. You can use this number to later detect if a player was last hit by this particular HitDef. This number is called the targetID. It is used in controllers such as TargetBind, or in the target(ID) redirection keyword. Valid values are all values >= 1. If omitted, defaults to 0 (no ID). TargetID is not to be confused with PlayerID.

params.name: chainID
params.description: Main use of this is for chain moves. If P2 was last hit by a move by P1 with this ID, only then can he be hit by the HitDef with this chainID. You can use this in the following parts of a chain move. Note that chain moves are still possible even without the use of the `id` and `chainid` parameters. Valid values are all values >= 1. If omitted, defaults to -1 (chain from any hit).

params.name: nochainID
params.description: nochainID specifies up to 2 ID numbers of hits which cannot be chained into this hit. If these are -1 (the default), then chaining is not explicitly disabled for any hit ID numbers. nochain_2 can be omitted. Except for -1, the values specified must not coincide with the value for chainID. This parameter has no effect if P2 is hit by a third party between P1's previous HitDef and the current HitDef.

params.name: hitonce
params.description: If set to 1, the HitDef only affects one opponent. If the hit is successful, all other targets will be dropped. Normally defaults to 0. The exception is if the `attr` parameter is a throw type, which makes it default to 1.

params.name: kill
params.description: Set to 0 if this hit should not be able to KO the opponent when the hit is successful. Defaults to 1.

params.name: guard.kill
params.description: Set to 0 if this hit should not be able to KO the opponent when the hit is guarded. Defaults to 1.

params.name: fall.kill
params.description: Set to 0 to prevent this attack from KO'ing the opponent when he falls on the ground (see fall.damage). Defaults to 1.

params.name: numhits
params.description: *hit_count* indicates how many hits this hitdef should add to the combo counter. Must be 0 or greater. Defaults to 1.

params.name: getpower
params.description: p1power specifies the amount of power to give P1 if this HitDef connects successfully. p1gpower specifies the amount of power to give P1 if this HitDef is guarded. If omitted, *p1power* defaults to *hit_damage* (from `damage` parameter) multiplied by the value of Default.Attack.LifeToPowerMul specified in `data/mugen.cfg`. If *p1gpower* is omitted, it defaults to the value specified for *p1power* divided by 2.

params.name: givepower
params.description: p2power specifies the amount of power to give P2 if this HitDef connects successfully. p2gpower specifies the amount of power to give P2 if this HitDef is guarded. If omitted, p1power defaults to *hit_damage* (from `damage` parameter) multiplied by the value of `Default.GetHit.LifeToPowerMul` specified in `data/mugen.cfg`. If *p1gpower* is omitted, it defaults to the value specified for *p1power* divided by 2.

params.name: palfx.add
params.description: If included, this allows for palette effects on P2 if the hit is successful. *palfx_time* is the time in game-ticks to apply palette effects on P2. *palfx_time* is 0 by default (no effect). The rest of the parameters are the same as in the PalFX controller.

params.name: envshake.phase
params.description: If included, this shakes the screen if the hit is successful. *envshake_time* is the time in game-ticks to shake the screen. The rest of the parameters are the same as in the EnvShake controller.

params.name: fall.envshake.phase
params.description: Similar to the envshake.\* parameters, except the effects are applied only when P2 hits the ground.

params.name: attack.depth
params.description: Specifies the range of the attack in the Z plane. An attack with more depth reaches further into or out of the Z plane. Defaults to the character's `attack.depth` size constant.

params.name: dizzypoints
params.description: Specifies the amount of dizzy points to give P2 if this HitDef connects successfully. If omitted, it defaults to hit_damage (from "damage" parameter) multiplied by the value of `Default.LifeToDizzyPointsMul` / `Super.LifeToDizzyPointsMul` specified in data/common.const, scaled by the targets' defense multipliers if necessary.

params.name: down.recover
params.description: This parameter controls the enemy's ability to use "fast recovery from lie down" after being hit.

params.name: down.recovertime
params.description: This parameter determines how long the enemy will stay down (in state 5110) after being knocked down. Defaults to the enemy's `data.liedown.time` constant. Together with `down.recover`, this allows one to effectively apply "hard knockdown" states on the enemy.

params.name: envshake.mul
params.description: For every envshake cycle, the envshake.ampl is multiplied by this value. Defaults to 1.

params.name: envshake.dir
params.description: Changes the direction in degrees in which the shake is applied. Defaults to 0. For a negative amplitude, 90 will make the screen shake from left to right.

params.name: fall.envshake.mul
params.description: For every fall.envshake cycle, the fall.envshake.ampl is multiplied by this value. Defaults to 1.

params.name: fall.envshake.dir
params.description: Changes the direction in degrees in which the shake is applied. Defaults to 0. For a negative amplitude, 90 will make the screen shake from left to right.

params.name: fall.zvelocity
params.description: This is the z-velocity that P2 gets when bouncing off the ground in the "fall" state. Defaults to no change if omitted.

params.name: forcecrouch
params.description: Forces a standing opponent to crouch upon hit. Similar to ForceStand. Defaults to 0.

params.name: guardpoints
params.description: Specifies the amount of guard points to give P2 if this HitDef is guarded. If omitted, it defaults to hit_damage (from "damage" parameter) multiplied by the value of `Default.LifeToGuardPointsMul` / `Super.LifeToGuardPointsMul` specified in data/common.const, scaled by the targets' defense multipliers if necessary.

params.name: guard.dist.width
params.description: Alternative syntax for guard.dist, for consistency with `guard.dist.height` and `guard.dist.depth`.

params.name: guard.dist.height
params.description: Specifies the vertical distance (height) within which a player's attack can trigger the enemy's proximity guard. The default value is 1000, 1000.

params.name: guard.dist.depth
params.description: Specifies the depth range (along the Z-axis) within which a player's attack can trigger the enemy's proximity guard. The default value is 4, 4.

params.name: guard.sparkangle
params.description: Specifies the guard spark rotation directly from a Hitdef. Defaults to 0.

params.name: guard.sparkscale
params.description: Specifies the guard spark's scale directly from a Hitdef. Defaults to 1, 1 (no change).

params.name: stand.friction
params.description: Overrides the opponent's Movement.Stand.Friction constants while they are in the gethit state caused by this HitDef.

params.name: crouch.friction
params.description: Overrides the opponent's Movement.Crouch.Friction constants while they are in the gethit state caused by this HitDef.

params.name: guardsound.channel
params.description: Specifies which of the player's sound channels the guardsound should play on. If omitted, channel_no defaults to -1, meaning the sound will play on any free channel.

params.name: hitsound.channel
params.description: Specifies which of the player's sound channels the hitsound should play on. If omitted, channel_no defaults to -1, meaning the sound will play on any free channel.

params.name: ignorereversaldef
params.description: If set to 1, this HitDef will ignore any active ReversalDef on the opponent, hitting them normally. Defaults to 0.

params.name: keepstate
params.description: If set to 1, the hit will apply effects (damage, hitpause, etc.) but the opponent will not change to a gethit state. Defaults to 0.

params.name: missonoverride
params.description: This parameter allows you to choose whether or not a HitDef will miss if it would be overridden(HitOverride), by default, it missing only if P1StateNo, P2StateNo, or P2GetP1State is specified. P1StateNo and P2StateNo both do not apply if the hit is overridden.

params.name: p2clsncheck
params.description: This parameter makes a hit be checked against a specific type of collision box. Valid values are `None`, `Clsn1`, `Clsn2`, `Size` and `Dummy` (nightly build only). Traditionally, fighting games check throws with the `Size` box.

params.name: p2clsnrequire
params.description:
This parameter prevents a hit from happening if the enemy lacks a particular type of collision box, regardless of them overlapping or not with the player.

Note: All Mugen characters were created on the assumption that lacking `Clsn2` makes them invulnerable. Therefore, if a character is designed for compatibility with other Mugen characters, this parameter should be used when checking hits against other types of collision boxes.

params.name: redlife
params.description: Specifies the amount of red life to give P2 if this HitDef connects successfully. If omitted, it defaults to hit_damage (from "damage" parameter) multiplied by the value of `Default.LifeToRedLifeMul` / `Super.LifeToRedLifeMul` specified in data/common.const, scaled by the targets' defense multipliers if necessary. Additional second value is optional and assigns an amount of guard red life to P2.

params.name: score
params.description: Specifies the score value added to P1 and P2 score count.

params.name: sparkangle
params.description: Specifies the hitspark rotation directly from a Hitdef. Defaults to 0.

params.name: sparkscale
params.description: Specifies the hit spark's scale directly from a Hitdef. Defaults to 1, 1 (no change).

params.name: teamside
params.description:
Makes the HitDef be treated as an attack from the TeamSide you specify (similar to the trigger of TeamSide).

When used with `Projectile`, setting a teamside different from the player's will allow the projectile to hit its owner and interact with other projectiles from the same player.

params.name: unhittabletime
params.description: Makes the player or the enemy invincible for the specified number of the frames after the hit. Use -1 for no change. Defaults to `p1_pausetime + 1, p1_pausetime + 1` for throw attribute attacks, `0, p1_pausetime + 1` for ReversalDef, or `-1, -1` otherwise.

params.name: xaccel
params.description: Specifies the x acceleration to impart to P2 if the hit connects. Defaults to 0. For backwards compatibility reasons, this acceleration is not used by default, as it is not called by `common1.cns`.

params.name: zaccel
params.description: Specifies the z acceleration to impart to P2 if the hit connects. Defaults to 0. For backwards compatibility reasons, this acceleration is not used by default, as it is not called by `common1.cns`.

sctrls.name: HitFallDamage
sctrls.description: When the player has been hit and is in a falling state, apply damage from the fall (specified in the hitdef) to the player.

sctrls.name: HitFallSet
sctrls.description: When the player has been hit, sets the player's fall variables.

params.name: value
params.description: If *fallset_flag* is -1, then this controller does not change whether the player will fall or not. A *fallset_flag* of 0 means that the player should not fall, and a 1 means that he should. Defaults to -1.

params.name: yvel
params.description: If specified, sets the player's fall.xvel and fall.yvel parameters, respectively. See HitDef for a description of these parameters.

sctrls.name: HitFallVel
sctrls.description: If the player has been hit and is in a falling state, sets the player's velocities to the fall velocities (fall.xvel and fall.yvel) specified in the HitDef.

sctrls.name: HitOverride
sctrls.description: Defines a hit override. If the player is hit by an attack of the specified type, he will go to the specified state number instead of his default gethit behavior. Up to 8 hit overrides can be active at one time.

params.name: attr
params.description: Standard hit attribute string specifying what types of hits to override. See HitDef's description for the `attr` parameter.

params.name: stateno
params.description: Specifies which state to go into if hit by a HitDef with the specified attributes.

params.name: slot
params.description: Specifies a slot number (0 to 7) to place this hit override in. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

params.name: time
params.description: Specifies how long this hit override should be active. Defaults to 1 (one tick). Set this to -1 to have this override last until overwritten by another one.

params.name: forceair
params.description: If set to 1, the player's gethit variables will be set as if he was in an aerial state when hit. Useful if you want to force the player to fall down from any hit. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

params.name: forceguard
params.description: If set to 1, a successful override will be considered a guarded attack.

params.name: guardflag
params.description: Only hits containing the specified flags in their `guardflag` will be overridden.

params.name: guardflag.not
params.description: Hits containing the specified flags in their `guardflag` will not be overridden.

params.name: keepstate
params.description: If set to 1, the character will override a hit without changing states at all.

sctrls.example:
[State Test]; Override attacks that can be blocked standing but not crouching (overheads)
type = HitOverride
trigger1 = 1
attr = SCA, AA
guardflag = H
guardflag.not = L

sctrls.name: HitVelSet
sctrls.description:
~~This controller is deprecated.~~

When the player has been hit, sets the desired components of the player's velocity to the appropriate gethit velocities.

params.name: x
params.description: A nonzero flag means to change that x-component of the player's velocity to the gethit velocity.

params.name: y
params.description: A nonzero flag means to change that y-component of the player's velocity to the gethit velocity.

params.name: Z
params.description: A nonzero flag means to change that z-component of the player's velocity to the gethit velocity.

sctrls.name: LifeAdd
sctrls.description: Adds the specified amount to the player's life, scaled by the player's defense multiplier if necessary.

params.name: value
params.description: Specifies amount of life to add to the player's life bar.

params.name: kill
params.description: If *kill_flag* is 0, then the addition will not take the player below 1 life point. Defaults to 1.

params.name: absolute
params.description: If *abs_flag* is 1, then exactly *add_amt* is added to the player's life (the defense multiplier is ignored). Defaults to 0.

sctrls.name: LifebarAction
sctrls.description: Displays text/sprites/anims synchronized with each other, using [lifebar data](https://github.com/ikemen-engine/Ikemen-GO/wiki/Lifebar-features#new_action). The intended use case is implementation of messages, often found in commercial fighting games.

sctrls.name: LifeSet
sctrls.description: Sets the player's life to the specified value.

params.name: value
params.description: Specifies amount of life that the player will have after execution.

sctrls.name: LoadFile
sctrls.description: Loads the specified data and overrides the data of the execution character. Note that all the data before reading will disappear.

params.name: savedata
params.description: Specifies the data type that should be read. Valid values for var_type are "var", "fvar", and "map".

params.name: path
params.description: Specifies the path of the file to be read (relative to the character folder). An error occurs if you make a mistake in the path.

params.name: maps
params.description: A list of maps to load. Defaults to empty.

params.name: maps.include
params.description: All maps containing this string in their names will be loaded. Defaults to empty.

sctrls.example:
[State Test]
type = LoadFile
trigger1 = time = 10
savedata = var
path = "kfm.gob"

sctrls.name: MakeDust
sctrls.description:
*This controller is deprecated; use the Explod controller.*

Creates dust effects.

params.name: pos
params.description: Specifies the position that the dust should be drawn at, relative to the player's axis. Defaults to `0, 0`.

params.name: pos2
params.description: Specifies the position to simultaneously draw a second dust cloud at. If omitted, the second dust cloud is not drawn.

params.name: spacing
params.description: Determines the number of frames to wait between drawing dust clouds. For instance, spacing = 3 (the default) will draw a new cloud of dust every third frame. spacing should be 1 or greater.

sctrls.name: MapAdd
sctrls.description: Adds a value to a player's map.

params.name: map
params.description: Specifies a name of the map that we add value to.

params.name: value
params.description: *expr* is the value to add to the map.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the map entry to assign. This lets a single map name act as an array. Index `0` is the same as having no index.

sctrls.example: mapAdd{map: "example"; value: 1}

sctrls.name: MapReset
sctrls.description: Clears all of the player's maps, except those containing the specified strings. Maps that are defined in the character's DEF file will be reset to the value specified there.

sctrls.name: MapSet
sctrls.description: Sets value to player's map. This state controller can be used to change a number that has already been set via character's DEF file or to set a new map.

params.name: map
params.description: Specifies a name of the map that we assign value to.

params.name: value
params.type: int or float, or string in nightly build
params.description: *expr* is the value to assign to the map.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the map entry to assign. This lets a single map name act as an array. Index `0` is the same as having no index.

sctrls.name: MatchRestart
sctrls.description: Reset the round or match and resume. By default (when no optional parameters are set) has the same effect as F4 debug key (round restart). Optionally allows characters and stage reloading, which also changes the state controller functionality to work like shift+F4 debug key (match restart).

params.name: pXdef
params.description: Path of the def file to read when reloading player 1-8 (replace X with player number). *char_path* can be relative to the folder of character that triggered MatchRestart or top ikemen directory.

params.name: stagedef
params.description: Path of the stage def file to read when reloading. *stage_path* can be relative to the folder of character that triggered MatchRestart or top ikemen directory.

params.name: reload
params.description:
This parameter specifies whether to reload particular character. Defaults to 0 (round is reset without characters reloading).

Note: Reloading files does not work during netplay due to synchronization limitations.

params.name: resetmatch
params.description:
If set to 1, the match will restart from Round 1 instead of the current round. Unlike standard reloading, this allows restarting the match without reloading assets (reload=0), making it compatible with netplay. Defaults to 0.

Note: This parameter will be ignored in Turns mode if the active characters have already switched and reload is not enabled, as the original characters are no longer in memory.

params.name: preservevars
params.description:
This parameter specifies whether to preserve variables (var, fvar, map) for a particular character after the restart. Defaults to 0.

Note: In the first round, the default common state will have all var and fvar reset by the varRangeSet in StateDef 5900. If you want to carry over variables to the first round, you will need to overwrite the StateDef 5900.

params.name: pXpalette
params.description: Specifies the palette number (1-12) to be used for player X (replace X with player number) upon restarting. If not specified, the character retains the currently selected palette.

sctrls.example:
[State Test]
type = MatchRestart
trigger1 = time = 10
p1def = "kfm.def"
p2def = "../suavedude/suavedude.def"
stagedef = "stages/stage0.def"
reload = 1, 1

sctrls.name: ModifyBGCtrl
sctrls.description: Modifies the parameters of an existing stage [background controller](http://www.elecbyte.com/mugendocs/bgs.html#background-controllers).

params.name: id
params.description: Specifies which controllers should be modified (all BGCtrl marked with [sctrlid](https://github.com/ikemen-engine/Ikemen-GO/wiki/Stage-features#bgctrl_sctrlid) will be affected)

params.name: time
params.description: time values that should modify background controller time parameter.

params.name: value
params.description: values that should modify background controller value parameter (used by following BGCtrl types: *Visible*, *Enabled*, *Anim*, *SinX*, *SinY*; only SinX and SinY use more than 1 value).

params.name: x
params.description: x value that should modify background controller *x* parameter (used by following BGCtrl types: *VelSet*, *VelAdd*, *PosSet*, *PosAdd*).

params.name: y
params.description: y value that should modify background controller *y* parameter (used by following BGCtrl types: *VelSet*, *VelAdd*, *PosSet*, *PosAdd*).

params.name: shader.name
params.description: shader name that should modify background controller *shader.name* parameter (used by following BGCtrl type: *ShaderSet*)

params.name: shader.paramX
params.description: shader params that should modify background controller *shader.paramX* parameter (used by following BGCtrl type: *ShaderSet*)

params.name: shader.texX.spr
params.description:
group and image that should modify background controller *shader.texN.spr* parameter (used by following BGCtrl type: *ShaderSet*)

shader.texX.anim = anim_no (int) (nightly build only) anim no that should modify background controller *shader.texN.anim* parameter (used by following BGCtrl type: *ShaderSet*)

sctrls.example:
[State Test]
trigger1 = 1
type = ModifyBGCtrl
sctrlID = 1
value = 0

sctrls.name: ModifyBGCtrl3D
sctrls.description: Modifies the parameters of an existing [3D stage background controller](https://github.com/ikemen-engine/Ikemen-GO/wiki/Stage-features-(3d)).

params.name: id
params.description: Specifies which controllers should be modified (all BGCtrl marked with [sctrlid](https://github.com/ikemen-engine/Ikemen-GO/wiki/Stage-features#bgctrl_sctrlid) will be affected)

params.name: time
params.description: time values that should modify background controller time parameter.

params.name: value
params.description: values that should modify background controller value parameter (used by following BGCtrl types: *Visible*, *Enabled*, *Anim*).

sctrls.example:
[State -2, Test]
type = ModifyBGCtrl3d
trigger1 = MoveType = A && Time = 1
id = 17
time = 0
value = 1

sctrls.name: ModifyBgm
sctrls.description: Modifies currently playing music.

params.name: volume
params.description: *volume_scale* alters volume for currently playing BGM.

params.name: loopstart
params.description: Changes the loop start position sample number.

params.name: loopend
params.description: Changes the loop end position sample number.

params.name: position
params.description: Sample point to where the music should seek.

params.name: freqmul
params.description: Frequency multiplier of the BGM (controls pitch & tempo). A value of 0 pauses the BGM.

params.name: loopcount
params.description: Changes the number of times this BGM should loop. A negative value makes it loop indefinitely.

sctrls.name: ModifyExplod
sctrls.description: Modifies the parameters of an existing Explod. Syntax is basically the same as Explod. ~~However, this controller is subject to future change. Any code relying on this controller is not guaranteed to work in the future.~~
changeNotes:
In general, characters with `ikemenversion` are able to to modify their explods more freely.

Additionally, if a character has `ikemenversion`, modifying an explod timer such as `bindtime` or `removetime` will use the current frame as the reference time. For example, if `removetime` is modified to 10, the explod will be removed 10 frames later, regardless of what the original time was.

params.name: anim
params.description: Modifies the `anim` parameter of an existing Explod. Requires `ikemenversion`.

params.name: animelem
params.description: Modifies the `animelem` parameter of an existing Explod.

params.name: animelemtime
params.description: Modifies the `animelemtime` parameter of an existing Explod.

params.name: ignorehitpause
params.description: Modifies the `ignorehitpause` parameter of an existing Explod. Requires `ikemenversion`.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the explod to be affected. Defaults to -1 (all).

params.name: space
params.description: Modifies the `space` parameter of an existing Explod. Requires `ikemenversion`.

params.name: under
params.description: Modifies the `under` parameter of an existing Explod.

params.name: ID
params.description: *id_no* specifies an ID number for this explod. Used to identify particular explods in triggers and controllers that affect explods.

params.name: pos
params.description: If the explod is not bound, *off_x* and *off_y* specify the position at which to create the explod. If the explod is bound, *off_x* and *off_y* specify the offset from the object to which the explod is bound to.

params.name: facing
params.description: Set *facing* to 1 to have the explod face in the same direction as the positive *off_x*, and -1 to have the explod face in the opposite direction. Defaults to 1.

params.name: vfacing
params.description: Set *vfacing* to -1 to have the explod display vertically flipped, or 1 to have the explod display vertically unflipped. Defaults to 1.

params.name: bindID
params.description: ID number of a player or helper to bind to. The position of a bound explod is relative to the object that it is bound to. Special values are -1 (bind to any single player) and -2 (do not bind). Defaults to -2.  The bindtime parameter is required if bindID is not -2. Screen space explods cannot be bound.

params.name: bindtime
params.description: Specifies the number of game ticks to keep the explod bound. After the bindtime has expired, the explod will be explod will no longer be bound to the bind point, and will maintain its position (unless affected by the vel or accel parameters). If *bind_time* is -1, then the explod will be bound until the explod is removed or another controller affects the bindtime.

params.name: vel
params.description: Specifies initial X and Y velocity components for the explod. These are interpreted relative to the explod's `facing` direction. These default to 0 if omitted.

params.name: accel
params.description: Specifies X and Y acceleration components for the explod. These default to 0.

params.name: removetime
params.description: If *rem_time* is positive, the explod will be removed after having been displayed for that number of game ticks. If *rem_time* is -1, the explod will be displayed indefinitely. If *rem_time* is -2, the explod will be removed when its animtime reaches 0. The default value is -2.

params.name: supermovetime
params.description: Specifies the number of ticks that the explod will be unfrozen during a SuperPause. Used where you want the explod to be animated during a SuperPause, such as for custom super sparks. Defaults to 0.

params.name: pausemovetime
params.description: Specifies the number of ticks that the explod should be unfrozen during a Pause. Defaults to 0.

params.name: scale
params.description: *x_scale* and *y_scale* specify the scaling factors to apply to the explod in the horizontal and vertical directions. Both default to 1 (no scaling) if omitted.

params.name: angle
params.description: *angle* specifies the explod's drawing angle in degrees. Defaults to 0.

params.name: yangle
params.description: *y_angle* specifies the explod's drawing angle around the y-axis in degrees. Defaults to 0.

params.name: xangle
params.description: *x_angle* specifies the explod's drawing angle around the x-axis in degrees. Defaults to 0.

params.name: sprpriority
params.description: *pr* specifies the drawing priority for the explod. Animations with higher priority get drawn over animations with lesser priority. For instance, setting `sprpriority = -3` will cause the explod to be drawn under most characters and other explods, which usually have `sprpriority >= -2`. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

params.name: ontop
params.description: Set `ontop = 1` to have the explod drawn over all other sprites and background layers. This parameter has precedence over sprpriority. Defaults to 0.

params.name: shadow
params.description: If *shadow* is not 0, a shadow will be drawn for the explod, else no shadow will be drawn. Defaults to 0.

params.name: ownpal
params.description:
If *ownpal_flag* is 0, the explod color will be affected by subsequent execution of the player's PalFX and RemapPal controllers. This is normally the default.

If *ownpal_flag* is 1, the explod color will not be affected by subsequent execution of the player's PalFX and RemapPal controllers. This is the default if the anim is from fightfx.air.

params.name: remappal
params.description: Forces a palette remap of the explod's indexed-color sprites to the specified palette. This parameter is used only if *ownpal_flag* is non-zero and a fight.def anim is not used. If *dst_pal_grp* is -1, this parameter will be ignored. Defaults to -1, 0.

params.name: removeongethit
params.description: Setting this to 1 will cause the explod removed if the player gets hit. Defaults to 0.

params.name: trans
params.description: Overrides the explod's animation transparency settings. See the Trans controller for details. An `alpha` parameter may be specified if trans_type is an additive type. If omitted, does nothing.

params.name: postype
params.description:
*postype_string* specifies how to interpret the pos parameters. In all cases, a positive *off_y* means a downward displacement.

Valid values for *postype_string* are the following:

**p1**

Interprets pos relative to p1's axis. A positive *off_x* is toward the front of p1. This is the default value for postype for characters with a `mugenversion` of 1.0 or less.

**p2**

Interprets pos relative to p2's axis. A positive *off_x* is toward the front of p2.

**front**

Interprets *off_x* relative to the edge of the screen that p1 is facing toward, and *off_y* relative to the top of the screen. A positive *off_x* is to the right of the screen, whereas a negative *off_x* is toward the…

params.name: random
params.description: Causes the explod's bind point to be displaced by a random amount when created. *rand_x* specifies the displacement range in the x direction, and *rand_y* specifies the displacement range in the y direction. For instance, if pos = 0, 0 and random = 40,80, then the explod's x location will be a random number between -20 and 19, and its y location will be a random number between -40 and 39. Both arg1 and arg2 default to 0 if omitted.

params.name: supermove
params.description: *This parameter is deprecated; use supermovetime parameter instead.* Set supermove = 1 to have the explod persist until the end of a super pause, regardless of the value of removetime. Defaults to 0.

params.name: AfterImage
params.description: Explods now support AfterImage parameters (e.g. afterimage.time, afterimage.length, afterimage.trans). Usage is identical to Projectile's AfterImage.

params.name: AnimPlayerNo
params.description: This parameter lets a explod use the specified animation from another character. Defaults to own playerno.

params.name: HideWithBars
params.description: This parameter hides the explod automatically when the fight screen is hidden. Defaults to 0.

params.name: SpritePlayerNo
params.description:
This parameter lets a explod use the specified sprites from another character. Defaults to own playerno.

This parameter lets a explod use the specified sprites from another character. Defaults to own playerno.

params.name: AnimFreeze
params.description: Freezes the explod's animation. Defaults to 0.

params.name: FocalLength
params.description: Focal Length of the projection. Does nothing when `projection` is not perspective or perspective2. This value is fixed in Mugen 1.1, the explods will look differently under different different resolution/loaclcoord/camera zoom. In Ikemen, this value scales internally like xy scales so that the explods will always look the same. Default value is 2048.

params.name: Friction
params.description: Applies friction to explod on the defined axis (Friction value example: 0.95).

params.name: interpolation.time
params.description: Specifies the time period of the animation (if omitted, defaults to 0).

params.name: interpolation.animelem
params.description: Specifies the target animelem for the interpolation. If animelem is omitted, defaults to 1. animfreeze will stop the animation from going further than interpolation.animelem.

params.name: interpolation.alpha
params.description: Specifies the source and destination alpha values for the interpolation. sub and add1 are not supported.

params.name: interpolation.angle
params.description:
Specifies the target angle, xangle, and yangle values for the interpolation.

Note: For the nightly build, these have been separated into individual parameters.

params.name: interpolation.offset
params.description: Specifies the target x and y offset values for the interpolation.

params.name: interpolation.scale
params.description: Specifies the target x and y scale values for the interpolation.

params.name: interpolation.xshear
params.description: Specifies the target xshear value.

params.name: interpolation.focallength
params.description:
Specifies the target focallength value.

PalFX is also compatible with the syntax. **interpolation.palfx.time** and **ownppal = 1** are required for any of the parameters to work.

params.name: interpolation.palfx.mul
params.description: Specifies the target red, green, and blue multiplication values. If palfx.mul is omitted, defaults to 256, 256, 256.

params.name: interpolation.palfx.add
params.description: Specifies the target red, green, and blue addition values. If palfx.add is omitted, defaults to 0, 0, 0.

params.name: interpolation.palfx.hue
params.description: Specifies the target hue value. If palfx.hue is omitted, defaults to 0.

params.name: interpolation.palfx.color
params.description:
Specifies the target color value. If palfx.color is omitted, defaults to 256.

These parameters can be used interchangeably.

params.name: LayerNo
params.description: Specify on which layer the explod should be drawn. Valid values are -1, 0 and 1. Defaults to the same layer as the player. Layer number 1 is effectively the same as the legacy `ontop` parameter.

params.name: PalFx
params.description: Apply palette effects on explods. The parameters are the same as in the HitDef controller. Requires `ownpal` to be a nonzero value.

params.name: Projection
params.description:
Affect how the explod is drawn when `xangle` or `yangle` is not zero.
- orthographic: The default value when Mugen version is not 1.1 or Ikemen version is not 0. The explod is drawn using orthographic projection.
- perspective: The default value when Mugen version is 1.1 and Ikemen version is 0. The explod is drawn using perspective projection. Distortion is affected by the position of the sprite relative to the center of the screen.
- perspective2: The explod is drawn using perspective projection. Distortion is affected by the position of the sprite relative to the center of the animation.

params.name: Reflection
params.description: If 0, disables reflection on the explod regardless of its shadow color. If 1, enables reflection on the explod regardless of its shadow color. Defaults to showing a reflection if the explod's shadow is not 0, 0, 0.

params.name: RemoveOnChangeState
params.description: If set to 1, the Explod will be removed if the character changes state. Defaults to 0.

params.name: Shader
params.description:
Specifying the name of the currently loaded custom shader will apply that shader to Explod.

Note: In the nightly build the syntax changed to `shader.name`.

params.name: ShaderTime
params.description:
Specifying this parameter will remove the custom shader after it has been displayed for the specified number of ticks. The default value is -1.

Note: In the nightly build the syntax changed to `shader.time`.

params.name: ShaderParam.pX
params.description:
Specifies the value to send to the custom shader. The value specified here can be used as a variable within the custom shader. X is limited to 0 to 15, and a maximum of 16 values ​​can be sent.

Note: In the nightly build the syntax changed to `shader.paramX`.

params.name: ShaderTexX.spr
params.description: Note: In the nightly build the syntax changed to `shader.texX.spr`.

params.name: ShaderTexX.anim
params.description:
Specifies the texture to send to the custom shader. The sprites specified here can be used as textures within the custom shader. You can specify 1 or 2 for X, and send up to two sprites. Each tex can be assigned either a sprite number (spr) or an anim number. It is not possible to assign both sprite and anim numbers to the same tex number simultaneously. Note that since textures are loaded as raw data, images with palettes may not display correctly as is.

Note: In the nightly build the syntax changed to `shader.texX.anim`.

params.name: shader.playerno
params.description: Specifies the player number who owns the shader to be used. Defaults to own player number.

params.name: shader.shadow
params.description: Specifies if the explod shadow is affected by the shader. Defaults to 1.

params.name: shader.reflection
params.description: Specifies if the explod reflection is affected by the shader. Defaults to 1.

params.name: shader.afterimage
params.description: Specifies if the explod afterimage is affected by the shader. Defaults to 1.

params.name: syncid
params.description: Specifies the ID of a character to synchronize with. The Explod will group with the target in the draw order. If syncparams is 1, it also copies the target's drawing properties (Position, Scale, Angle, Trans, etc.).

params.name: synclayer
params.description:
Adjusts the drawing order relative to the character specified in syncid.
* 0: Same layer as the character (default).
* \> 0: Drawn in front of the character.
* < 0: Drawn behind the character.

params.name: syncparams
params.description: If set to 1, visual parameters (Scale, Angle, Trans, etc.) are continuously copied from the character specified in syncid. If set to 0, only the draw order is synchronized. Defaults to 1.

params.name: window
params.description: This parameter takes four numbers (similar to the format of a Clsn box) which forms a rectangle outside of which the pixels will not be rendered.

params.name: xshear
params.description: Specifies the amount of horizontal shearing to apply to the explod. Defaults to 0.

sctrls.name: ModifyHitDef
sctrls.description: Using this state controller will update the specified parameters of the player's currently active `HitDef`. Has no effect if no `HitDef` is active.
sctrls.example:
[State Test]
type = ModifyHitdef
trigger1 = AnimElem = 5
hitFlag = MA
damage = 100, 25

sctrls.name: ModifyPlayer
sctrls.description:
Allows changing some player parameters that are otherwise out of reach, or don't justify having their own dedicated state controllers. Some parameters should be used with care.

Note: This state controller was briefly named `ModifyChar` during development. A previous nightly state controller named `MoveHitSet` was also integrated into it.

params.name: ailevel
params.description: Sets the character's ailevel.

params.name: alive
params.description: Toggles the character's alive flag on or off.

params.name: attack
params.description: Changes the player's attack value.

params.name: defence
params.description: Changes the player's defence value.

params.name: displayname
params.description: Changes the character's displayname.

params.name: lifebarname
params.description: Changes the character's lifebarname.

params.name: lifemax
params.description: Changes the character's maximum life points.

params.name: powermax
params.description: Changes the character's maximum life points.

params.name: dizzypointsmax
params.description: Changes the character's maximum dizzy points.

params.name: guardpointsmax
params.description: Changes the character's maximum guardpoints.

params.name: teamside
params.description: Changes the character's team side.

params.name: helpervar.ID
params.description: Changes a helper's helper ID.

params.name: helpername
params.description: Changes a helper's name.

params.name: movehit
params.description: Sets the player's MoveHit timer to the specified value.

params.name: moveguarded
params.description: Sets the player's MoveGuarded timer to the specified value.

params.name: movereversed
params.description: Sets the player's MoveReversed timer to the specified value.

params.name: movecountered
params.description: Toggles the player's MoveCountered flag on or off.

params.name: hitpausetime
params.description: Sets the player's hitpausetime to the specified value.

params.name: pausemovetime
params.description: Sets the player's pausemovetime to the specified value.

params.name: supermovetime
params.description: Sets the player's supermovetime to the specified value.

params.name: unhittabletime
params.description: Sets the player's "unhittable" timer to the specified value.

sctrls.example:

sctrls.description: Using this state controller will update the specified parameters for the projectiles with the specified `ID`. Syntax is essentially the same as for `Projectile`.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the projectile to modify. Defaults to -1 (all the player's projectiles)

sctrls.name: ModifySnd
sctrls.description: Modifies the following sound parameters on-the-fly. This cannot modify the `lowpriority` parameter. If you need your sound to be low priority, call PlaySnd with the respective parameter set.

params.name: channel
params.description: The sound channel to modify. Use -1 to modify all sound channels on the entity.

params.name: volume
params.description: Changes the volume of the specified sound channel.

params.name: volumescale
params.description: Changes the volume scale of the specified sound channel.

params.name: freqmul
params.description: Changes the sound channel's frequency multiplier.

params.name: pan
params.description: Changes the sound channel's pan.

params.name: abspan
params.description: Changes the sound channel's absolute pan.

params.name: priority
params.description: Changes the sound channel's priority.

params.name: loopstart
params.description: Changes the sound's loop start point.

params.name: loopend
params.description: Changes the sound's loop end point.

params.name: position
params.description: Changes the position of the currently playing sound. Behavior is undefined when the channel is unspecified (-1).

params.name: loop
params.description: Changes whether or not this sound should loop forever (nonzero) or not at all (0). This parameter is ignored if `loopcount` is nonzero.

params.name: loopcount
params.description: Changes the number of times this sound should loop.

sctrls.example:
[State Test]
type = ModifySnd
trigger1 = FightTime
channel = 5
volumescale = floor(50*(1 + cos(pi*fightTime/256)))
freqmul = 1 + cos(pi*fightTime/256)

sctrls.name: ModifyStageBG
sctrls.description: This state controller allows modifying the stage's BG elements. Refer to stage documentation for more information.

params.name: pos.x

params.name: pos.y
params.description: Changes the Y position in relation to the starting position.

params.name: spriteno

params.name: start.x

params.name: start.y

params.description: Changes the scalestart parameter.

params.name: velocity.x

sctrls.name: ModifyStageVar
sctrls.description: This SCTRL lets a character modify basic stage parameters or "stage vars", as declared in the stage .def file. Not all parameters are modifable for now, but the SCTRL could be expanded in the future to allow it.

sctrls.name: ModifyStoryboard
sctrls.description: Using this state controller will update the specified parameters of currently active `Storyboard` instances with the specified `ID`. Syntax is essentially the same as for `Storyboard`.

params.name: ID
params.description: The ID of the storyboards to modify. Defaults to -1 (all the player's active storyboards).

params.name: space
params.description: Changes the coordinate space used by the storyboard. `none` uses the storyboard's normal rendering and coordinate system without applying match placement or camera transforms.

params.name: pos
params.description: Changes the storyboard's position offset.

params.name: scale
params.description: Changes the storyboard's horizontal and vertical scale.

params.name: facing
params.description: Changes the storyboard's horizontal facing. Negative values make it face left; zero or positive values make it face right.

params.name: bindid
params.description: Changes the player ID the storyboard is bound to. A value of -1 binds it to the player executing the state controller.

params.name: bindtime
params.description: Changes how long the storyboard remains bound to the player specified by `bindid`. A value of -1 binds it indefinitely.

sctrls.example:
[State Test]
type = ModifyStoryboard
trigger1 = Time = 30
ID = 100
pos = 20, -10
